summary.text: Elaine Marzola is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 21 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, she chairs the Commerce and Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: Marzola was born in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
She earned a B.S. in women's studies from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, in 2006 and a J.D. from the Western Michigan University Thomas M. Cooley Law School in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney and a judicial law clerk.
Marzola assumed office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Ozzie Fumo.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor Committee as chair, the Judiciary Committee as vice chair, and the Natural Resources Committee.
